driver_checkin.sms: Temperature alert {shipment_id}. Pull over safely and check WhatsApp.
driver_checkin.whatsapp: Shipment {shipment_id} is at {temperature_c} C, above its safe range. Please pull over safely before replying. Is the refrigeration unit running?

driver_ack.whatsapp: Thanks, noted: {answer}. We're checking the shipment now.

facility_ack.whatsapp: Thank you. Your {answer} response to the cold-storage request has been recorded.

facility_request.whatsapp: Emergency cold storage request for shipment {shipment_id}. Required range: {range}. Expected arrival in about {minutes} minutes. Can you accept it?

facility_reminder.whatsapp: Reminder: shipment {shipment_id} needs emergency cold storage at {facility_name} within about {minutes} minutes. Please accept or decline so we can plan.

driver_reroute.whatsapp: Please take shipment {shipment_id} to {facility_name}, about {minutes} minutes away. They are expecting you. Directions: {directions} Tap below when you are on your way.

status_update.whatsapp: Update on shipment {shipment_id}: {status}. Next step: {next_step}. No action is needed from you.

reopen_alert.whatsapp: Shipment {shipment_id} has risen above its safe range again at {facility_name} ({temperature_c} C). The incident is reopened and the team is responding. Any earlier QA request is withdrawn, and an updated report will follow.
